description: A combined annotation for configuration, component scanning and auto-configuration, placed on one main class.
A dependency that brings a curated set of libraries for one purpose, such as spring-boot-starter-webmvc for REST endpoints.
Beans that Spring Boot creates from the classpath and properties, applied only when their conditions hold.
A condition that applies a default bean only when the application has not defined one of that type.
The log output enabled by --debug that lists which auto-configurations matched, which did not and why.
A bean that adjusts an auto-configured component, such as a JSON mapper builder, without replacing it.
The META-INF/spring/org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.AutoConfiguration.imports file that lists the auto-configuration classes of a jar.
